evidence: Modifies `src/torcontrol.cpp`, which manages Tor control port integration for onion service setup covered under P2P.
rationale: Fixes an authentication failure with the Tor control port when `-torpassword` contains backslash characters. The PR description notes that without escaping backslashes, bitcoind logs `tor: Authentication failed` and fails to create the onion service with `ADD_ONION` when passwords contain backslashes. This fixes an edge-case protocol encoding bug affecting Tor integration.
